entries.title: Job 12:1
segments: And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 12:2
segments: For truly you [are] the people, and wisdom will die with you.

entries.title: Job 12:3
segments: But I have understanding as well as you; I do not fall [short] of you; yes, who does not know such things as these?

entries.title: Job 12:4
segments: I [am] a laughing-stock to his friends; who calls on God, and He answers him; the just, the upright one [is] a mockery;

entries.title: Job 12:5
segments: a flaming brand despised in the thoughts of him who feels secure; [it is] ready for those with slipping feet.

entries.title: Job 12:6
segments: The tents of robbers are at peace, and those who provoke God [are] secure, in whatever God brings to their hand.

entries.title: Job 12:7
segments: But now ask the animals, and they shall teach you; and the birds of the air, and they shall tell you;

entries.title: Job 12:8
segments: or speak to the earth, and it shall teach you; and the fish of the sea shall declare [it] to you;

entries.title: Job 12:9
segments: who of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this?

entries.title: Job 12:10
segments: In whose hand [is] the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all flesh, [even] of man?

entries.title: Job 12:11
segments: Does not the ear try words? And does not the mouth taste its food?

entries.title: Job 12:12
segments: With the aged [is] wisdom, and understanding in length of days.

entries.title: Job 12:13
segments: With Him [is] wisdom and strength; He has wisdom and understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:14
segments: Behold, He breaks down, and it can not be built up again; He shuts up a man, and no one opens.

entries.title: Job 12:15
segments: Behold, He withholds the waters, and they dry up; also He sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

entries.title: Job 12:16
segments: With Him [is] strength and sound wisdom; the deceived and the deceiver [are] His.

entries.title: Job 12:17
segments: He leads wise men away stripped, and makes the judges fools.

entries.title: Job 12:18
segments: He cuts away the bonds of kings, and binds their loins with a girdle.

entries.title: Job 12:19
segments: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

entries.title: Job 12:20
segments: [He] removes the speech of the men of trust, and takes away the understanding of the aged.

entries.title: Job 12:21
segments: He pours scorn on princes, and unties the belt of the mighty.

entries.title: Job 12:22
segments: He discovers deep things out of darkness, and brings the shadow of death to light.

entries.title: Job 12:23
segments: He gives greatness to the nations, and destroys them. He spreads out the nations, and leads them away.

entries.title: Job 12:24
segments: He takes away the heart of the chief of the people of the land, and causes them to wander in a wilderness [where there is] no path.

entries.title: Job 12:25
segments: They grope in the dark without light, and He makes them to stagger like [a] drunkard.
